title: Jr. HR Executive
description:
Junior HR Executive Location: Rajkot Experience: 1-2 Years Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented Junior HR Executive to join our HR team. The ideal candidate will support day-to-day HR operations, employee engagement, recruitment, onboarding, and HR administration while ensuring a smooth employee experience. Key Responsibilities Assist in end-to-end recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and candidate communication. Coordinate the onboarding and joining formalities of new employees. Maintain and update employee records, HR documents, and databases. Assist with attendance, leave, and HRMS-related activities. Support the preparation of HR letters, certificates, and other employee-related documents. Handle routine employee queries and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution. Assist in organizing employee engagement activities, events, and training programs. Support performance management and employee feedback processes. Ensure HR policies and processes are communicated and followed effectively. Other HR administrative activities. Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR-related matters. Perform other HR and administrative tasks as assigned. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational and time-management abilities. Basic understanding of HR processes and employment practices. Good working knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace. Familiarity with HRMS and recruitment platforms will be an advantage. Ability to handle multiple tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong attention to detail. What We re Looking For Someone who enjoys working with people. A proactive individual with a problem-solving mindset. Good follow-up and coordination skills. A responsible and detail-oriented professional who can maintain confidentiality.
